# Validation matrix

Labels, weakest to strongest: **not run**, **blocked**, **static checks passed**, **smoke tested** (ran end to end on a fixture, outputs inspected, no known answer), **functionally verified** (a known answer was checked: a planted failure caught and a fixed control passed, or output matched a reference tool). Visual or audible review is recorded separately and only when someone actually looked or listened. A mocked or dry-run provider call is never a provider pass.

**Platform of every recorded run: Linux (cloud container), headless Chromium with SwiftShader software WebGL.** Nothing has been run on native Windows or macOS. Windows support is implemented and documented, and its status is **unverified** until the commands in [SETUP.md](SETUP.md#verify-on-windows) are run on a Windows machine and recorded here.

Summary: 15 functionally verified, 11 smoke tested, 4 static checks passed, 1 blocked, 0 not run (of 31).

Static layer (`node tools/validate.mjs`, 2026-11-13): 495/495 checks pass (discover 86/86, metadata 93/93, contract 31/31, links 167/167, parse 113/113, license 3/3, secrets 1/1, platform 1/1).
